label: TP
reason: User input from HttpServletRequest parameters flows directly into Base64 encode/decode operations which preserve arbitrary characters including HTML/script tags. The resulting 'bar' string is then passed to response.getWriter().format(), which writes the tainted string directly into the HTTP response body without any HTML escaping or context-aware sanitization. This allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts via XSS.

evidence.note: Source: User parameter extracted from request.getParameterNames() and request.getParameterValues()
Processing: Base64 decode followed by encode preserves all original bytes including script tags.
Sink: Tainted variable 'bar' written to response via format() without HTML entity encoding.
